queries.query: If my company runs cargo ships that call at European ports, what do we have to measure and report about their CO2?
queries.notes: Maritime MRV Regulation 2015/757. Avoids 'monitoring', 'emissions', names no instrument.

queries.query: How much pollution is allowed in total under the EU carbon market, and how do factories get their permits?
queries.notes: ETS Directive 2003/87 + 2023 revision 2023/959. 'carbon market'=ETS, 'permits'=allowances, 'pollution allowed in total'=cap.

queries.query: How does the EU decide whether a business activity counts as genuinely green?
queries.notes: Taxonomy Regulation 2020/852. 'genuinely green'=environmentally sustainable; instrument unnamed.

queries.query: Which emission-cutting targets is each EU country legally on the hook for in areas like transport and farming?
queries.notes: Effort Sharing Regulation 2018/842 + 2023 amendment 2023/857. Non-ETS sectors.

queries.query: When goods come into the EU, how do they figure out how much carbon went into making them?
queries.notes: CBAM Regulation 2023/956. 'carbon that went into making them'=embedded emissions; CBAM unnamed.

queries.query: What rules apply to countries for the carbon stored or released by their forests and farmland?
queries.notes: LULUCF Regulation 2018/841 + 2023 amendment 2023/839. Avoids the LULUCF acronym.

queries.query: Where exactly is the EU's promise to be climate neutral by 2050 written into law?
queries.notes: European Climate Law 2021/1119.

queries.query: Is there EU money to help poorer households cope when carbon prices push up their bills?
queries.notes: Social Climate Fund Regulation 2023/955. 'poorer households'=vulnerable groups.

queries.query: How does selling carbon permits at auction work in the current trading phase?
queries.notes: ETS Directive 2003/87 + revision 2023/959, Phase 4 auctioning.

queries.query: Before the carbon border charge fully kicks in, what paperwork do importers need to file?
queries.notes: CBAM transitional implementing reg 2023/1773 + CBAM 2023/956. 'before it fully kicks in'=transitional period.

queries.query: What exact tests prove an activity really helps fight climate change for green-investment purposes?
queries.notes: Taxonomy Climate Delegated Reg 2021/2139 + 2020/852. 'exact tests'=technical screening criteria, 'helps fight climate change'=substantial contribution to mitigation.

queries.query: What do investment funds have to tell people about how green their products actually are?
queries.notes: Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Reg 2021/2178 + 2020/852.

queries.query: What goes into a country's combined energy-and-climate plan, and when is it due?
queries.notes: Governance Regulation 2018/1999, NECPs.

queries.query: How do EU countries report their yearly greenhouse gas totals?
queries.notes: Monitoring Mechanism Reg 525/2013 + implementing reg 2014/749.

queries.query: In what form do governments have to report the steps they're taking to cut emissions?
queries.notes: Governance implementing reg 2020/1208 + 2018/1999. 'steps they're taking'=policies and measures.

queries.query: Do countries have to send Brussels a long-range plan for going low-carbon?
queries.notes: Governance Regulation 2018/1999, long-term strategies.

queries.query: What emissions-tracking plan do airlines have to file under the carbon market?
queries.notes: ETS revision 2023/959, aircraft operator monitoring plans.

queries.query: How did flying get pulled into the EU carbon market, and which flights does it cover?
queries.notes: Aviation ETS Directive 2008/101 amending 2003/87.

queries.query: How much energy are member states required to save overall under EU efficiency rules?
queries.notes: Energy Efficiency Directive recast 2023/1791, savings obligation.

queries.query: What does a company have to do before it can call its bond an official EU green bond?
queries.notes: European Green Bond Standards Regulation 2023/2631.

queries.query: How do the outfits that vet green bonds get registered and kept in check?
queries.notes: EuGB 2023/2631 + implementing reg 2025/755 on ESMA fees. 'outfits that vet'=external reviewers.

queries.query: What does a carbon-removal or soil project need to qualify for EU certification?
queries.notes: Carbon Removal Certification Framework 2024/3012.

queries.query: How do you tell whether a meadow is too rich in wildlife to be ploughed up for biofuel crops?
queries.notes: Implementing Reg 2014/1307 on grassland sustainability. 'too rich in wildlife'=highly biodiverse grassland.

queries.query: Has the EU pinned down a 2040 climate goal yet, and how does it sit with the 2050 one?
queries.notes: European Climate Law 2021/1119 + amendment 2026/667 adding the 2040 target.

queries.query: Why do some heavy industries get free carbon permits, and how is that amount worked out?
queries.notes: ETS 2003/87 + revision 2023/959, free allocation / carbon leakage.

queries.query: What is the EU planning to do about keeping soil healthy and cutting down on contamination?
queries.notes: Soil Monitoring Directive 2025/2360.

queries.query: What's the system that keeps track of who holds which carbon allowances?
queries.notes: Registry implementing reg 2018/208 + ETS 2003/87. 'system that keeps track'=Union Registry.

queries.query: How is the baseline for forest emissions set when judging how well a country is doing on land accounting?
queries.notes: LULUCF Regulation 2018/841, forest reference levels.

queries.query: How is the carbon-border bill trimmed to account for the free permits domestic producers already get?
queries.notes: Implementing Reg 2025/2620 on CBAM free-allocation adjustment + CBAM 2023/956.

queries.query: What quality checks go into putting together the EU-wide greenhouse gas figures?
queries.notes: Union GHG Inventory Reg 2014/666 + Monitoring Mechanism 525/2013. Note: Union-level, vs q018 member-state level.

queries.query: What progress updates do member states owe under the EU's energy and climate governance setup?
queries.notes: Governance Regulation 2018/1999 + implementing reg 2020/1208.

queries.query: How are yearly emission limits handed out to countries for the sectors that sit outside the carbon market?
queries.notes: Effort Sharing Reg 2018/842 + 2023 amendment 2023/857.

queries.query: What restoration duties cover seas, coasts and rivers under the EU nature law?
queries.notes: Nature Restoration Regulation 2024/1991, marine/coastal/freshwater.

queries.query: What's the 'don't make anything else worse' test for activities in the EU green-investment rules?
queries.notes: Taxonomy Delegated Reg 2021/2139 + 2020/852. 'don't make anything else worse'=do no significant harm (DNSH).

queries.query: What does a country need to put in its plan to tap the fund that cushions carbon-price impacts?
queries.notes: Social Climate Fund Regulation 2023/955, national social climate plans.

queries.query: What kind of environment and transport projects does the EU's cohesion money pay for?
queries.notes: Cohesion Fund Regulation 2013/1300.

queries.query: How do you work out how much of a regional-funding programme counts as climate spending?
queries.notes: Implementing Reg 2014/215, methodology for climate-tagged structural fund expenditure.

queries.query: How and when do the green-investment technical criteria get reviewed?
queries.notes: Taxonomy amendment 2022/1214 (review provision) + Delegated Reg 2021/2139.

queries.query: What goes into the two-yearly progress report on the decarbonisation side of the governance rules?
queries.notes: Governance reporting implementing reg 2022/2299 + 2018/1999. 'two-yearly'=biennial.

queries.query: How does the EU recovery fund steer carbon-auction money into the energy transition?
queries.notes: RRF amendment 2023/435, REPowerEU chapter and ETS revenue.

queries.query: What standards of trustworthiness and qualifications do the bosses at green-bond reviewers need?
queries.notes: EuGB implementing reg 2025/2180 (repute criteria) + EuGB 2023/2631. 'trustworthiness'=good repute.

queries.query: When can a carbon-import checker do a remote inspection instead of turning up at the site?
queries.notes: CBAM verification implementing reg 2025/2546 + CBAM 2023/956.

queries.query: How is the price of a carbon border certificate set from the EU carbon auction results each quarter?
queries.notes: CBAM certificate price implementing reg 2025/2548 + CBAM 2023/956.

queries.query: Do smaller companies get any kind of break from the EU green-investment disclosure rules?
queries.notes: Taxonomy disclosure amendment 2026/73 (SME derogations) + Delegated Reg 2021/2178. 'any kind of break'=derogation.

queries.query: How do projects that suck carbon out of the air and bury it get certified under the EU removal rules?
queries.notes: CRCF implementing reg 2026/285 (DACCS methodology) + CRCF 2024/3012. 'suck carbon out of the air and bury it'=direct air capture with storage.

queries.query: What yearly land-sector emission and removal limits apply to countries from 2026 to 2029?
queries.notes: LULUCF implementing reg 2026/893 (annual limits) + LULUCF 2018/841.

queries.query: Can the EU social fund be tapped to help workers and towns recover after a natural disaster?
queries.notes: ESF+ amendment 2024/3236, support for natural-disaster consequences.

queries.query: What changed in the standard reporting tables countries use for their governance progress reports?
queries.notes: Governance reporting amendment 2024/1281 + implementing reg 2020/1208.

queries.query: What standard template do countries have to use when handing in their nature restoration plans?
queries.notes: Nature Restoration plan format implementing reg 2025/912 + Nature Restoration 2024/1991.
